visual_enhancers.clay_morphism: Darkened clay: mix soft ambient outer shadow (shadow-2xl shadow-black/40) with a sharp 1px inner border (border border-white/5) and a faint white top-inner-glow to simulate matte tactile surfaces.
visual_enhancers.liquid_glass: Premium glassmorphism: bg-teal-900/10 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10. Used for sticky navigation, floating stat cards, and overlay modals. MUST use backdrop-saturate-150.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Subtle, non-linear. E.g., radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(216,92,69,0.15), transparent 50%). Avoid loud full-screen gradients. Keep them as background 'auras'.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. gap-8 to gap-12 for grids.
layouts.grids: Bento Grid protocol for feature sections. Asymmetric and dense. For programme cards, use a 4-col grid on desktop (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4) with h-full stretch.
layouts.hero: Full viewport height (min-h-[90vh]). Use a dark overlay (bg-black/60) over a premium video or image. Left-aligned massive typography. Floating liquid glass stats cards overlapping the bottom edge.
layouts.pricing_section: 3 tiers (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3). Middle tier is highly elevated (scale-105) with a glowing terracotta border or tracing beam effect.

motion.interactions: Hover states must lift cards (-translate-y-2) and increase border opacity. Buttons should have a slight scale down on click (active:scale-95).
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in-up for hero elements and grid items (framer-motion).
motion.scroll: Parallax scrolling on hero background images. Use lenis for smooth scrolling if possible.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all terracotta/teal text against dark backgrounds passes WCAG AA. Use text-white over terracotta buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='pricing-plan-buy-button').

media.treatment: Images must be wrapped in overflow-hidden containers with a subtle dark overlay (bg-black/20) and a slow scale effect on hover (hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-700). Never use pure black overlays that kill the image.

landing_page.hero: Dark mode hero with massive Bricolage Grotesque typography. Use a background video or rich image with a bg-black/60 overlay. Overlapping liquid-glass navigation bar. CTA buttons should be pill-shaped, using the vibrant terracotta color.
landing_page.programmes: 4 cards in a grid. Use dark clay-morphism cards. Deep teal backgrounds with terracotta accents on hover. Image at the top (h-48), content below. Left aligned text.
landing_page.how_it_works: Vertical timeline or staggered alternating layout. Large numbers (01, 02) using text-gray-800 to fade into the background. Minimalist.
landing_page.pricing: 3 tiers (15k Monthly, 30k 3 Months, 85k Yearly). Middle tier highlighted with 'The Tracing Beam' border effect (liquid glass glow) and scale-105.

membership_page_logged_in.layout: Dense dashboard hybrid approach. Sidebar or top-nav with liquid glass.
membership_page_logged_in.current_status: A premium clay-morphism card at the top showing current active plan. Deep teal background with glowing terracotta text for 'Active'.
membership_page_logged_in.plan_upgrades: 3 plan cards with the new pricing + highlighted recommended plan. Add a 'Per Session: ₹1000' callout as a floating badge or sub-text. Razorpay Pay button should be highly visible.
membership_page_logged_in.payment_history: Clean table or list view using Manrope font. text-sm. Subtle border-b border-white/10 for rows.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The codebase uses .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write all React code in .js (JSX).
Implement in React using Tailwind CSS and lucide-react icons.
MUST use Framer Motion for liquid glass sticky navigation and staggered card entrances.
Do NOT use pure #000000. Use the dark obsidian/charcoal colors specified (#0A0B0E).
Ensure all buttons and links have data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use any emojis in the UI.
Pricing is strictly: ₹15,000 (Monthly), ₹30,000 (3 Months), ₹85,000 (Yearly), and Session ₹1,000. Update the content to reflect this perfectly.
Keep existing routes and app functionality intact. The redesign should purely elevate the UI/UX visually.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Do NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background
